title: Xtra Power DC Wheel NX Series Grinding Wheel, 100mm/125mm/180mm Diameter, 6mm Thickness, Pack of 10 (100mm Diameter, 6mm Thickness, 16 mm Arbor Hole)
description: The Xtra Power DC Wheel NX Series Grinding Wheel is a robust and reliable abrasive wheel designed for demanding grinding and cutting applications. Available in three diameter options — 100mm, 125mm, and 180mm — with a consistent 6mm thickness, this wheel offers versatility across a wide range of tasks. The arbor hole sizes of 16mm and 22.23mm ensure compatibility with most standard angle grinders and power tools. Engineered for precision and durability, the NX Series delivers consistent performance whether you are working on metal fabrication, surface preparation, or heavy-duty grinding jobs. Each pack contains 10 wheels, making it an excellent choice for professionals and workshops that require a steady supply of high-quality abrasive wheels. The sturdy construction ensures long-lasting use even under continuous operation, reducing downtime and improving productivity on the job site.
